csv_scope_of_work: Procurement and installation of data center HVAC components and associated electrical distribution upgrades to support the new HVAC systems. The objective of this project is to engineer and install the required electrical and mechanical infrastructure to support high-density IT equipment loads in applicable rooms. This effort includes the installation of a new redundant liquid cooling system and the necessary power distribution upgrades. The new infrastructure must integrate with the existing Building Automation System. The contractor shall provide all associated design, installation, programming, submittals, and as-built documentation.
